title: Book Three · Chapter 64: The Bag for Mrs Deng
story:
On Tuesday, Ronan runs his two laps after school.

Anna does not hide the bench. She is there with her bottle when he finishes. He sits beside her until his breath grows quiet.

At home, Leo's tenth reply is on the table. He likes Anna's copied window. He has put it beside his school books and returned the library book with his aunt.

Ronan reads the short letter, then leaves it near his pen. Mum has a finished coat beside her chair.

“Mrs Deng's,” she says. “I need to take it to the fruit shop on Saturday.”

“I can go.”

Mum looks at him. “It is near the bus stop. You know the shop.”

“The oranges outside?”

“Yes. Before noon. She has already paid.”

Ronan lifts the bag. It is not heavy. Mum has folded the coat inside a clean sheet of paper.

On Saturday, he takes it along the lane. He walks. The bag stays flat against his side.

At the fruit shop, Mrs Deng is helping a woman choose pears. Ronan waits near the door until she finishes.

“From Mum,” he says.

Mrs Deng wipes her hands on a cloth and opens the bag. She takes out the coat and puts it on.

The sleeve now ends at her wrist. She bends her arm, then reaches for a pear.

“Better.”

Ronan smiles. “It can work in the shop.”

“It needs to.”

She takes it off and hangs it behind the counter. Then she asks about the trousers on a chair.

“Can your mother shorten these too?”

“I can take the question home. She needs to look first.”

“All right. I will bring them on Monday.”

Ronan folds the empty bag. Mrs Deng picks up two small oranges and offers them to him.

“For the walk.”

He thanks her and puts them in the bag. On the way home, he eats one slowly. He saves the other for Mum.

At the green door, Mr Qiu asks about the empty coat bag.

“A new coat for you?”

“It would be short.”

Mr Qiu looks at his long arms and nods.

Inside, Mum is starting another sleeve. Ronan gives her the orange and tells her about the trousers.

“Monday,” she says. “Good. I can measure them then.”

She asks about the coat. He shows her where the sleeve ended on Mrs Deng's wrist.

Mum smiles and opens the orange. Ronan takes his book into the yard. He has the rest of the morning for himself, and the clean bag is back beside Mum's chair.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

fruit shop＝水果店；paid＝已付钱；shorten＝改短；measure＝量尺寸。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan送的是什么，是否需要代收钱或搬重物？
2. Mrs Deng问改裤子时，Ronan有没有替Mum承诺价钱和交期？

## 读句子

**The bag stays flat against his side.**

拆开看：The bag / stays flat / against his side.

袋子／平整地贴着／贴在他身体一侧。
